gnome.name: Gnome Raider
gnome.description: Sneaky garden raider that sprints to the pond to drag a tadpole off-screen.

armored_beetle.name: Armored Rhinoceros Beetle
armored_beetle.description: Heavy tank with impervious frontal carapace. Stomp Spacebar to flip onto its back!

wasp.name: Stinger Wasp
wasp.description: Erratic aerial dive-bomber. Vulnerable to Chain Lightning and Steam Burst.

crow.name: Pond Crow
crow.description: Circling scavenger. Watch for its growing ground shadow and snatch it mid-dive.

boss_mower.name: Lawn Mower King
boss_mower.description: Terrifying garden shredder. Snatch the fuel can on its back to stun it, then slam!
